newsitem.title: UK: SBC set warrants on BASF /Hoechst.
newsitem.headline: SBC set warrants on BASF /Hoechst.

text.p: Schweizerischer Bankverein (Deutschland) AG said it has issued one million European-style warrants, on BASF AG and Hoechst AG ; there are 500,000 warrants on each.
BASF AG WARRANT DETAILS:
CAP LEVEL 70.0 DEM RATIO 1/1
ISSUE PRICE 60.51 MIN EXER LOT NONE
EXPIRATION 19.DEC.97 PAYDATE 06.JUN.97
LISTING FFURT, DUSS SPOT REF 63.55 DEM
NOTES ON EXPIRATION ONE WARRANT ENTITLES THE HOLDER
TO RECEIVE 70.00 DEM IF THE CLOSING PRICE
IS ABOVE 70.00 DEM.
IF CLOSING PRICE IS AT OR BELOW 70.0 DEM
HOLDER RECEIVES ONE BASF SHARE FOR ONE WARRANT
HOECHST AG WARRANT DETAILS:
CAP LEVEL 73.0 DEM RATIO 1/1
ISSUE PRICE 63.79 MIN EXER LOT NONE
EXPIRATION 19.DEC.97 PAYDATE 06.JUN.97
LISTING FFURT, DUSS SPOT REF 67.44 DEM
NOTES ON EXPIRATION ONE WARRANT ENTITLES THE HOLDER
TO RECEIVE 73.00 DEM IF THE CLOSING PRICE
IS ABOVE 73.00 DEM.
IF CLOSING PRICE IS AT OR BELOW 73.0 DEM
HOLDER RECEIVES ONE HOECHST SHARE FOR ONE
WARRANT.
-- Reuter London Newsroom +44 171 542 7658
